description: moaa-core guard: a note (never a block) when Bash or PowerShell runs long or multi-line inline python -c code

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/guard.py" hook pre-tool; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 0
